maddeler.e:
نتلاعب (form VI)
# نَتَلَاعَبُ (natalāʕabu) /na.ta.laː.ʕa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
# نَتَلَاعَبَ (natalāʕaba) /na.ta.laː.ʕa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
# نَتَلَاعَبْ (natalāʕab) /na.ta.laː.ʕab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
